svg.title: Inside a dream
svg.desc: Top: a dream starts when a peer has at least 50 new explicit conclusions, at least 8 hours after the last dream, and then 60 minutes pass with no new messages; or when an application schedules one. Below, dream 2 of the first server run. The deduction agent, at most 12 rounds: round 1 asks for the 20 newest conclusions and gets the whole store, 19 rows; round 2 writes two deductions, the update and 'resides in Kreuzberg'; round 3 deletes one row, the vegetarian fact; round 4 rewrites the peer card with 'Diet: Pescatarian'; round 5 answers DONE. Its rounds read 2,551 to 4,069 tokens. The induction agent, at most 10 rounds: round 1 asks for the 20 newest; round 2 writes two patterns, one of which is rejected because its ids do not resolve; round 3 sends that pattern again with correct ids; round 4 answers DONE.
svg.text: Two agents run one after the other. Each sees only what its tools return, and stops when it answers DONE.
